verdict.rationale: AngelList documents an Open Cap Table Format (OCF) export of the cap table and Excel exports of its reports. It also helps companies move to other cap table providers such as J.P. Morgan and Pulley, and community users describe how to delete an account. That covers the core of portable exit for equity data, but only the cap table has a documented open-format export, not all data. Missing for 10: evidence of a complete all-data export (documents, board consents, stakeholder records, fund and investor data), documentation of OCF export scope or fidelity, and independent or hands-on confirmation of migrating out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
